title_zh: 先了解节庆习俗再布置入口

scenario.label_zh: 加入传统节庆志愿活动
scenario.goal_zh: 了解社团目标和节庆习俗并约定首次帮忙的工作

context_zh: 新志愿者加入社区传统节庆，询问组织宗旨和入口布置的意义。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: I have not helped at this cultural festival before. What does your group focus on?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: We help neighbours share their family traditions through food, music, and stories.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: I noticed everyone ties a ribbon near the entrance. Is that a local custom?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: It is a custom brought by some of our members. They will explain its meaning during the opening.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: How can I help before then?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Could you decorate the welcome table with these flowers? Leave room for the small flag in the middle.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Of course. I will start with the flowers and check the layout with you before moving the flag.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: Thank you. After that, you can join the welcome team and hear the opening stories.
